text:
These wizards specialise in manipulating and
pilfering the magics of other spellcasters, stealing
their power and making it their own.

Starting at 2nd level when you choose this
school, you gain an Arcane Vault, a tiny object
which you can use as an arcane focus.

You can use this Vault to dispel and seal
spells.
As an action touch a creature, object, or
magical effect caused by a spell and make an
Intelligence check, DC 10 + the spell's level.
On a successful check, the spell ends on the
target and is sealed in your Vault.

You have disadvantage on the check if the
spell is to high a level for you to cast.

The Vault can seal one spell at a time and can
be emptied with your Stolen Power feature or
during a short rest where you can turn the
power into a temporary hit die that
disappears if not used by the end of
the short rest.

At 2nd level, you may use a spell slot of the
same level or higher than the spell sealed in
the Vault to cast it even if it is not a wizard
spell.

Beginning at 6th level, your Vault may now
hold 2 spells.
If the Vault holds two spells you may use an
action to Launder them, turning them back
into raw magic which restores a spell slot of
one type lower than the lowest level spell
sealed in the Vault, minimum 1st level.

You can use this feature a number of times
equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier. When
you finish a long rest, you regain all expended
uses.

Starting at 10th level, you can cast Counter
Spell or Dispel Magic at third level without
using a spell slot once between long rests .
If you successfully counter or dispel a spell
with this effect then it’s sealed in the Vault if
it has room for it.

At 14th level, when a creature casts a spell
within 6oft of you, you may use your reaction
to immediately make a contested Arcana
check with the spellcaster.
If you win you absorb the spell into your
Vault (even if it’s full) and then immediately
spit it back out treating it as if you cast it
yourself.
This feature burns a spell slot of 3rd level or
higher.
Each time you use this feature after the first
it requires a higher level spell slot, resetting
when you finish a long rest.
